Home.introTitle: Developing Credible and Contextual Islamic Studies
Home.introDescription: The Faculty of Ushuluddin and Islamic Thought (FUSPI) at UIN Sultan Maulana Hasanuddin Banten serves as a center for integrative Islamic scholarship. With three excellent study programs, FUSPI is committed to producing graduates who are profound in Islamic sciences while responsive to contemporary dynamics.
